title: Lamb Dumplings
description: A hearty Croatian dish featuring tender lamb and fluffy dumplings. This recipe is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and black pepper.
In a large skillet, cook the diced bacon over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb shoulder to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Transfer the lamb to a baking dish and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt.
Mix the dough until smooth and elastic.
Knead the dough on a floured surface until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball of dough into a disk using a rolling pin.
Place a tablespoon of the lamb mixture onto the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the dumplings for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Serve the dumplings hot with the lamb and sauce.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
